items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: He was most tolerant of people like Teagarden... Like Miff Mole or Jack Teagarden... I think Benny's date was 'Oh, Pappy,' what he did with Jack Teagarden

ctx.x: With Some people he was different. He was a strange man in a lot of ways. He was over tolerant for some people and intolerant to other people. And what made him that way was something I'll never understand. He was most tolerant of people like Teagarden, and other people like that and Bix, to the degree of being nearly not good for the band. And, yet, other people he was very exacting to. And --

items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: He taught Jack Tea -- I mean Charlie Teagarden how to fly.

ctx.x: He'd fly, he'd fly an airplane. He taught Jack Tea -- I mean Charlie Teagarden how to fly.
